text: Water was the motor of that old stone mill.
translation: 水是那座老石磨的原动力。
note: 驱动机器的力 = 原动力

text: The sun is the motor of all plant life here.
translation: 太阳是这里一切植物生命的原动力。

text: A strong motor turns the whole old wheel.
translation: 一个强力的原动力带动整个旧轮子。

text: He found the real motor of her success.
translation: 他找到了她成功的真正原动力。
note: 比喻：动力根源 = 原动力

text: The motor part of this fan was new.
translation: 这台风扇的马达部分是新的。
note: 马达本身的 = 马达的

text: A small motor cover sits under that seat.
translation: 那个座位下面有一个小马达罩。

text: His motor skills are poor this year.
translation: 他今年的马达技术很差。

text: We ordered two spare motor parts for the machine.
translation: 我们为这台机器订了两个备用马达件。
note: 配件（口语用法）= 马达的

text: The motor engine of this car is very old.
translation: 这辆车的发动机很老了。
note: 汽车发动机 = 发动机的

text: His motor car broke down on the long road.
translation: 他的汽车在长路上抛锚了。

text: A motor engine turns this small wheel here.
translation: 一台发动机带动这里这个小轮子。

text: The motor engine stopped and never ran again.
translation: 发动机停了，再也没有动过。

text: His old motor cost more than the whole car.
translation: 他那辆旧车比整车还贵。

text: She bought a small white motor last spring.
translation: 她去年春天买了一辆白色小车。

text: A loud motor passed our house at night.
translation: 夜里一辆轰鸣的车经过我家。

text: They drove that old motor all the way south.
translation: 他们把那辆旧车一路开到了南方。

text: His own hard work was the motor of the whole project.
clue: the motor of the whole project
translation: 他本人的努力是整个项目的原动力。

text: The motor end of that wire is bare.
translation: 那根线的马达端是裸露的。

text: That motor engine needs a new belt.
translation: 那台发动机需要一条新皮带。

text: His small motor is older than his son.
translation: 他那辆小车比他还老。
